name: zsnd_sample_init_from_wave_data_dispatch
description: zSndSample::InitFromWaveData dispatches parsed wave initialization to the active sound backend.
known_limits: The dispatcher wrapper is tier S by local VC byte verification. The broader zSound sample initialization cluster still has backend tier S debt in the DirectSound and A3D initialization bodies.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a2ea0 validates dispatch on g_zSnd_ActiveBackend: 0 calls InitFromWaveData_DirectSound, 1 calls InitFromWaveData_A3D, and all other values return 0.
The DirectSound smoke now exercises the wrapper with g_zSnd_ActiveBackend set to 0 after validating the direct DirectSound initializer.
The A3D smoke now exercises the wrapper with g_zSnd_ActiveBackend set to 1 after validating the direct A3D initializer, and verifies unsupported backend values return 0.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4a2ea0 with local target zsnd_sample_init_from_wave_data_dispatch passed under VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs with zero unmasked mismatches after 12 relocation-masked bytes; BN size is 30, object size is 32, and 2 trailing VC NOP bytes were trimmed. Earlier source shapes failed at 18 and 13 mismatches; switch-form dispatch with local result storage reproduces the retail sub/dec selector flow.
